run: 2026-11-18 final historical pressure analysis, revised filter (top 35% pressure balls)

method.filter: pooled top 35% pressure balls, both innings, common calibrated scale; only filtered balls enter player estimates
method.recency: 365-day half-life at the player estimate; population fit unweighted
method.score: 100 x Normal cumulative probability of the standardized pressure-performance estimate; 50 = role population mean; no uncertainty penalty

intervals: 80% score intervals conditional on the 32-draw rating mixture with fixed models and hyperparameters; wide; not full-pipeline coverage
